procedure: Started from bare CentOS GenericCloud without Docker; failures were corrected and installation resumed, including a guest-kernel reboot. Final installer and AmneziaWG were validated after the fixes; this was an iterative clean-VM test, not a single uninterrupted cold run of the final bytes.

resolved_causes.cause: firewalld 2.4 annotates active zone names with (default)
resolved_causes.fix: Parse and validate the actual zone name

resolved_causes.cause: Incorrect policy query flags and runtime-only priority restriction
resolved_causes.fix: Verify active policies and runtime/permanent --info-policy with exact IPv4/IPv6 rules

resolved_causes.cause: Cloud image running kernel 278 lacked xt_addrtype while dnf installed modules for kernel 279
resolved_causes.fix: Try matching modules for running kernel; install full new kernel and request explicit reboot/resume if retired

resolved_causes.cause: Standard SELinux container_t cannot connect to the host-agent Unix socket
resolved_causes.fix: Dedicated confined vpn_console_t with the Unix connect permission; ordinary container negative control stayed denied

resolved_causes.cause: amneziawg-go failed UAPI socket inotify watch with permission denied under default container policy
resolved_causes.fix: Dedicated vpn_amnezia_t with socket watch and existing namespace network permissions; actual daemon/tools/listen socket/router checks passed
